notes.title: Demo Update (1.0.1) - Features and Fixes
notes.notes:
[p]Have you taken over the maps in the Demo yet? It's best with a friend to outsmart...

Development continues on full game features, but also [b]support for the Demo[/b] to continue refining and updated.
[/p][p]New Feature: Guide (v1)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000437/a45bd047231b08b59af06e23986c822315158aab.png"][/img][/p][p][i]This new guide will be expanded upon to address the depth of strategy for new players. I'm dedicated to making onboarding as robust as I can, so expect further guide categories and settings options![/i][/p][p][/p][h3]Demo v 1.0.1[/h3][p][/p][p]ːsteamthisː New Feature: Guide (above) has been added across all menus[/p][p]ːsteamthisː New Feature: Additional sounds [/p][p]ːsteamthisː Offline mode: Supports saved Steam name (ie. on Deck without wifi)[/p][p]ːsteamthisː Feature Update: Exhausted tiles are more easily restored, and in all shape configurations[/p][p]ːsteamthisː Feature Update: Colonies preview tool has overhauled visibility and easier deactivation[/p][p][/p][p]Adjustments:[/p][list][*][p]Tutorial: Stronger flow to teaching special tiles[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial: UI/General improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Map shapes, including number of tiles, and amounts of special tiles improved[/p][/*][*][p]Clarification for Advanced Bloom build requirements[/p][/*][/list][p]Bugs:[/p][list][*][p]Users were able to lock themselves out of expansion in Tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]Exhausted event on previous system interfered with goal completion[/p][/*][*][p]Several UI bugs (pop-ups)[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]During release testing[/b], I really enjoyed how broken up this [i]Bisected[/i] map became.  It was quiet maze-like, and filled quickly with two CPU's taking over. [i]BubbleFins[/i] of all sizes were on display.
[/p][p]You can note the tooltip as I hove the [b]Climate: Hydrated[/b] state causing an energy boom.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000437/8316795706ca4fdb2ee4be5356fad9ded6362945.png"][/img]Stay tuned, and as always [url="https://discord.gg/ZNV5q284KH" style="button"]I'm listening via Discord[/url] or in-game Feedback Surveys.  Love the feedback thus far, and keep up that real world fungi interest. There is so much to discover.[/p][p][/p][p]- Jake (SporeBloom Creator)[/p]
